issues.issue: P3 editor: 'Apply changes' is pinned in the bottom-right corner roughly 200px below the last right-panel control, separated from the 'Unsaved changes' label it answers, with a large empty column between them.
P3 cliplist: the Keep/Maybe/Skip pills in each row are about 10px with tight padding, making the triage control the smallest text on the row it exists to serve.

P3 error: 'Retry stage' and 'Start over' sit side by side with no line saying what each one redoes, so a creator cannot tell whether Start over throws away the completed Inspect and Extract audio steps.
P6 cliplist: the hovered row's kebab button renders on top of the 'Last Viewed' value for that row (over '9:24 AM'), so the row action covers its own data while the menu is open.

P6 editor: the unavailable AI Tools rows (Eye Contact, Center active speaker, Green screen, Blur speaker background) are near #c8c8c8 on white, so they read as removed content rather than features that exist and are off.
P6 editor: the transport bar's last control is clipped by the AI Tools panel edge at about x=975, leaving a cut-off icon and partial label visible.

P1 cliplist: three bare identifiers ('d591db2c-0a82-482e-a8c8-5f93768b9a24', '69e48d8e849ab9426f17022d', 'composer-5gohk1eo6') sit as unlabeled body text between the tab row and the Tracks heading, reading as leaked debug output.
P1 cliplist: Create, Ask Co-Creator, Generate with AI and Export all are four filled or outlined buttons in the top-right cluster at nearly the same weight, so none of them is the obvious first move.

P1 editor: in the Audio panel the active tab is 'Sound Effects' while the field under it still reads 'Search music', and the Ready-made collections strip clips its third tile ('Educati' cut) under an arrow overlay.

P4 cliplist: the 'Auto headline' notice is a full-width two-line paragraph above the clip row, pushing the clips down half the screen, and its 'Disable it' action sits about 700px away at the far right of the text.
P4 editor: timeline labels ('Fill', 'AI image B-roll', 'Slow push') render at roughly 8px, smaller than any other text in the product, and 'Fill' repeats on ten-plus consecutive segments.
P4 cliplist: the far-left navigation is a bare column of unlabeled outline icons sitting on the page background outside the main panel, clipped at the window edge with no container or active state.
P5 cliplist: label chips in the middle column start at a different x per row (about x=723, 866, 1114), so the label column reads as ragged and status cannot be scanned down the list.
P5 cliplist: the primary identifier is what gets cut ('Integrate internationalization (i18n) supp...', 'Add responsive and accessible UI behavi...') while the label chips beside it keep full text.

P5 editor: the right sidebar mixes one labeled tab ('Properties') with two glyph-only tabs, and Done, Urgent, olivia and Labels all render at identical weight, so nothing on the panel says what to do next.
P2 cliplist: an unlabeled, cropped pixel mosaic block sits above 'Video editing' at the top of the left sidebar, reading as a broken thumbnail rather than part of the nav.
P2 cliplist: project names and durations under the grid are around 11px in mid-gray on near-black, and '0919(1)' and '0918 (3)' barely separate from the background next to the thumbnails.
P2 editor: the timeline toolbar carries six multicolor striped audio icon buttons beside otherwise monochrome outline controls, and the Export teal differs from the clip's timeline teal.

notes: Only P3 has an error screen, so every other product's empty/error score comes from its cliplist and editor alone; P5's screens are a text issue tracker rather than a clip tool, judged on interface only. Strongest per category: typography P6, hierarchy and primary action P3, spacing, color, components and icons P5, error states P3.
